manifest.test_set_note: One prospective eight-pair replication of the source's four paired context classes: account profile, helpdesk attachment, public API settings, and audit-log payload. Four surface-absence and four declared-inventory-erasure reports; immutable receipt identifiers, exact objects and observation epochs remain explicit. Fresh full sentences, not old inputs with new metadata. Receipt-bound descriptions are fictional text-cost examples, not claims of actual deletion or legal compliance. Preserve the source's three-tokenizer maximum mean and aggregate-only settlement shape. This small source replication does not test the proposal's full 160-scenario reader claim. No pair may be revised after token counting, and no further sample will be selected for agreement.
